wu: Warm-up: 'Pass the Pumpkin' - children sit in a circle, pass a toy pumpkin while chanting 'Trick or treat?', stop the music, child holding pumpkin says 'I see a [color pumpkin]'.
wuAlt: Alternative warm-up 1: 'Halloween Charades' - children act out pumpkin, witch, ghost, candy for others to guess.
Alternative warm-up 2: 'Count the Candies' - show flashcards of candy, children count 'One candy, two candies...'.
pres: Presentation: Show flashcards of pumpkin, witch, ghost, candy; model and drill pronunciation. Present a short story about a witch using 'The witch was happy. She went to the house. She saw a ghost.'; check understanding with 'Who was happy? Where did she go?'
presAlt: Alternative presentation 1: Use a picture book with Halloween images to introduce vocabulary and story frames.
Alternative presentation 2: Use a puppet to act out the story with 'was/went/saw' sentences.
prac: Guided practice: 'Story Order' - children work in pairs to match picture cards to the story sentences; support with sentence starters 'The witch...' and 'She...'.
pracAlt: Alternative practice 1: 'Fill-in-the-Blank' - complete sentences with was/went/saw using word cards.
Alternative practice 2: 'Roleplay the Story' - children act out the story with simple props.
ls: Listening slot: Children listen to a recorded Halloween story and order 4 picture cards; check by having them retell the story using 'was/went/saw'.
re: Reactivation game: 'Simon Says' with Halloween actions - 'Simon says be a ghost!', 'Simon says pretend to eat candy!' to bring back vocabulary and energy.
prod: Production task: 'Halloween Rhyme Time' - groups write a 4-line rhyme about Halloween using the target words, then perform it to the class with actions.
rw: Reading and writing slot: Children read a short Halloween text and circle the words pumpkin, witch, ghost, candy; then write 3 sentences about the story using past simple.
st: Story/song + goodbye: Sing 'The Halloween Song' (tune: 'Twinkle Twinkle') with actions; end with the goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line.
g: Children pass a pumpkin while music plays, stop and child says a Halloween word.
Teams race to put on witch's hats and say 'I am a witch!'.
Match ghost picture cards to word cards.
Count candy flashcards and say 'I see [number] candies.'
Freeze when story stops, child says what happened next.
diff: Fast finishers / stronger learners: Write a 5-line rhyme with extra Halloween words.
Support / weaker learners: Use word banks with pictures to write sentences.
hw: Homework option 1: Draw a Halloween picture and write 2 sentences about it using past simple.
Homework option 2: Teach a family member the 'I am from Morocco' chant and perform it.
Homework option 3: Prepare 2 facts about Halloween to tell the class.
tip: Use the American Space Oujda's cultural context to link Halloween to Moroccan storytelling traditions, making the theme relatable and engaging.
